model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of languages within the dataset, with the purpose of representing the relative frequency of different language types. The chart contains nine slices, representing English, Spanish, Portuguese, Catalan (Brazil), French, German, Russian, Thai, and Chinese. The largest slice, English, is displayed in dark blue and occupies approximately 42.8% of the pie. The second largest slice, Spanish, is presented in a lighter blue shade and constitutes about 31.4%. The Portuguese slice is a pale blue and accounts for approximately 5.8%, while the Catalan (Brazil) slice is a lavender color and represents roughly 2.5%. The French, German, Russian, Thai, and Chinese slices are represented in pink, light blue, light green, light yellow, and light purple respectively, and their respective proportions appear to be around 3.6%, 2.9%, 5.7%, 1.9%, and 2.5%. Percentage labels are visible inside each slice, indicating the approximate values. There is no legend provided, and none of the slices are visually emphasized beyond their size. The slices appear to be ordered from largest to smallest in terms of their area.
